_about: Overnight Oct 17, Part 11: hand-written input for tools/npc_truth.js (merged into data/npcs/npcs.json): passing barks (one-liners an NPC says when the hero walks by), a short description, and species for NPCs the sheet leaves blank. Edit here and re-run the tool after an NPC import.

NPC-ELDER: Slow and steady, dearie. I invented that. The hare has never forgiven me.
The kettle's on and the pie is cooling. Neither is for you. Both are for you.
NPC-GATEKEEPER: Hm. Wrote you in the book. 'Stranger, damp.' I'll fix it when you know.
Hm. Gate's never locked. Somebody might come home late.
V-SABLE: Two typos, darling. One misprint. Such a small card, such a complicated past.
Where's it from? The past, darling. Next question.
V-TONIC: Fresh tonics! Tested them all this morning! I'm teal! Teal means it works!
Emergency tonic! Works on Tuesdays too! That's when I test the emergency tonic!
V-BEETSWORTH: Fact: bears cannot open the drawer. Nobody opens the drawer. Protocol One.
Assistant TO the Regional Merchant. The TO is load-bearing. Say it.
V-THREADWELL: Hat! Your next adventure needs a dramatic opening! Preferably above the eyebrows!
Gossip: there's a cloak on a very muscly island. I've said too much. Hat!
V-FENWICK: Shh. That crinkle? Foil. Please let it finish.
Free a road and its pack comes in. I'll be here, providing shelf esteem.
V-ALEMBIC: The flasks are humming today, dear. Don't touch the red one. It bites.
They say one spring once fed all four Paths. Mixed, dear. Like a good soup.
NPC-BELLOWS: LADIES AND GENTLEMEN! ...Oh. Just you. Hi. THE ECHO SAYS HI TOO.
IN THIS CORNER: MY LUNCH! (normal voice) It's soup. The soup is winning.
NPC-HOB: Checked my book. You're not in it. Not for a good long while. Heh.
Business has been slow for ten years. Not my fault. Paperwork. Heh.
NPC-BRONSON: Never lift alone. An old man told me that. Never broke, they say. Huh.
Hydration. Stretching. Sorry, am I ordering again? I meant we could do them together.
NPC-GRAVOIS: Taste it. Go on. Somebody in this kingdom ought to taste something.
The pantry key is shaped like a ladle. Don't ask why. The answer is soup.
NPC-MULLIGAN: ...the green is hungry... Oh! Sorry. Did I thorn at you? I thorn when nervous.
The raccoons are very good boys. Don't tell them. They'll get ideas.
NPC-PALLOR: Stamp, stamp. Old habits die hard. Unlike me.
I own two stamps: DENIED and APPROVED. One of them is very well rested.
V-BENCHLEY: LET'S GO! Cards are protein for your deck! Regime-approved! (They are not.)
Floorboard? WHAT floorboard? Do NOT stand on the floorboard! LET'S GO!
NPC-HURL: Three... two... oh, I already threw someone. Sorry. Enthusiasm.
Never once missed. The landing is your part. I believe in your part.
NPC-RIP: HNNNGH. Thank you for ripping with the Express. Please don't look at the seam.
Shirt number two hundred and thirteen. Very proud of it. Notice my form?
NPC-PUMP: Pop quiz! Kidding. Unless... no. Even brain-ceps need a rest day.
Read the signs, student. Every answer is there. Consider it a slow circuit of the gym.
NPC-THUNDERABS: But WAIT, there's MORE! Act now for a SECOND set of reps! Reps not included!
Operators are standing by! It's me! I tried sitting! LOST THE ENERGY!
NPC-MOUNTAIN: Rule one: never lift alone. Rule two... rule two is... where was I.
There was a boy at the Lifting Festival once. Four colours in his hands... hm.
V-LEDGERBONE: Form 12-B for purchases. Filled in correctly? Oh. Oh, that's lovely.
The stamp wants a raise. I have given it the form. It is thinking.
NPC-ECTOMUND: Three hundred years, the same quiz. The answers have never been fresher.
The ethics questions were removed by management. Ethically, I object.
NPC-KYLE: is it still '09 out there? no? huh. brb, updating my away message.
brb, haunting. actually stay. nobody reads the 'be right back' part.
NPC-GERALD: Four million two hundred and twelve. They're on three. Any minute now.
Coffee? Nobody can taste it. I make it anyway. It's the thought.
NPC-AGNES: Employee of the month since 1987, dear. The plaque is getting heavy.
Appeal forty thousand and one. Denied. I'm starting to take it personally.
V-MIREPOIX: This deck is underdressed, darling. A little butter. A little foil. Voila.
Decorative cake, darling. Please admire it without cutlery.
NPC-PATE: A good answer is like a roux: patience, then butter. Mostly butter.
Chalk again. Notes of limestone. Excellent body, no business being in my mouth.
NPC-FLAMBE: ORDER UP! Sixty seconds and a dream! WHOOSH! Mostly the dream!
Savannah Souffle calls that plating? WHOOSH! That's the sound of me declining to comment!
NPC-BASIL: Chef ALWAYS tastes. Always. That's how you know it's Chef.
I'm brave. I'm brave. ...Have you seen my thyme? I'm running out of it.
V-GRISTLE: Found, not stolen, dearie! The raccoon found it. I just held on tight. Heh!
Shed grew another room, dearie. At last, a growing business I don't have to water. Heh!
NPC-THISTLEWICK: Every thought has a bin. Most of mine go in compost. That is not a complaint.
The dishwasher talks back. I listen. Wisdom sometimes arrives with a rinse cycle.
NPC-RHONDA: Reduce! Reuse! Recy-CLUE: that one goes in the green bin!
Captain Compost Badger says: rinse first! ...Who says I do the voice?
NPC-BRAMBLE: The vines whisper now. It's not right. Also SOMEBODY ate the compost AGAIN.
Eleven little trees in a row, one per birthday. Then nobody came for the twelfth.
NPC-WREN: Keep your head down and your hope up. Hope's unapproved. Carry it anyway.
He likes things perfect. We like things alive. Keep moving.
V-FIGSLY: You didn't see me. I didn't see you. We're both very sneaky.
Rare cards, no questions, some answers.
NPC-KESTREL: Psst. Chalk on the left means go. Chalk on the right means I got bored.
Guards change on the hour. I change whenever I like. Keep up.
NPC-PELL: He has been in the parlour three years. I still tell him when someone comes to the door.
27-B needs 27-C. 27-C needs 27-B. I keep both forms beside his chair.
NPC-ROLLO: Ten years... on the wheel... my calves... have calves.
Trained with... the Gainlands wheel crews. They told us... it was cardio.
NPC-MARLO: Psst. Bread: some flour, a bit of water, enough time. You didn't hear it here.
Down here we cook with all the heat and none of the sky. Smell that? Contraband.
NPC-FERN: Untidy, they call me. Dirt's supposed to be untidy. That's how it works.
The worms in my hat are unapproved. So am I. We get along.
NPC-CITIZEN: Everything is perfect! Everything is... (whisper) is it raining? I liked rain.
Smile! It's mandatory! Eight degrees! ...Is mine at eight? Please say eight.
NPC-ISLA: Dad says hi. We have so much to tell each other. Sometimes we just sit together.
Eight years up that road. I knew every turn on the way home. Dad was still at the gate.
NPC-VILLAGER: Fresh bread! Flour in my whiskers again. Occupational dusting. Anyone want a roll?
I knead a holiday. Then I knead the dough. Busy, busy badger.
NPC-FLEX: Breathe in. Hold. ...Now lift. The breath was the hard part.
They took the iron, son. The iron was only ever a guest.
NPC-ESCOFFINA: Have you eaten? Sit. Eat. Then save the kingdom. In that order.
A full table is a safe table. Pull up a chair. That is an order.
NPC-MORTIMER: Number four million two hundred and fourteen. I have begun to understand Gerald.
I have filed my impatience in triplicate. It is still being processed.
NPC-COMPOSTELLA: Everything grows back, child. Even me. Especially me.
About the barn... I will help mend it. The goat may prefer that I begin elsewhere.
NPC-DOPPEL: I tasted my soup today. As me. Too salty. It was mine.
Third-class apprentice. Many dishes. I am trying. The dishes are also trying.
NPC-PRIMM: I am designing a drain. It will not be perfect. I am learning to let that be.
Good day. I owe you rather more than that. I am told it is a start.
NPC-SPOTLESS: HALT. State your height. No, do not state it. STAND at it.
A SMUDGE is TREASON! ...It's on me, isn't it. It's always on me.
NPC-TOWNSFOLK: Lovely day for a quest, isn't it? Shh. Not too lovely. Somebody's listening.
The old cottage cheers at night now. From the cellar. I'm choosing to love it.
The well hummed at me. Wells don't hum. I said thank you anyway.
Four plinths round the fountain, and nobody remembers what stood on them.

NPC-CITIZEN: Everything is... not perfect! It rained on Thursday! I stood in it for an hour!
I smiled at eleven degrees today. Nobody wrote it down. I may do it again.
NPC-WREN: The record is open. Every name in it. That was the whole fight, really.
Tea's on in the Crease. The grudges can wait. Most of them.
NPC-KESTREL: No more chalk. I keep drawing arrows anyway. Habit. Also it's fun.
Guards still change on the hour. Now they wave. It's deeply unsettling.
NPC-SPOTLESS: HALT. ...At ease. I am practising at ease. It is VERY difficult.
A smudge on my sleeve. I have decided to allow it. Retroactively.
NPC-ROLLO: No wheel... and my legs... keep going anyway. Ghost cardio.
The crews took a day off. Then another. We're... getting good at it.
NPC-MARLO: Bread in the open. Some flour, some water, all the sky. Smell that? Legal.
The paste vats are planters now. I'm growing some garlic. Lots of some.
NPC-FERN: They asked me to tidy the square. I said no. They said thank you. Strange times.
The worms have a permit now. They're furious about it.

descriptions.NPC-ELDER: Crosspath's tortoise elder and keeper of the Wanderer's lost memories.
descriptions.NPC-GATEKEEPER: The bear who guards the Capital road and hands out the kingdom's biggest quest.
descriptions.V-SABLE: A fox card dealer with a story for every card and a price for every story.
descriptions.V-TONIC: A frog apothecary selling potions, charms and occasionally soup.
descriptions.V-BEETSWORTH: The rule-bound equipment vendor who runs the level-5 armory quest.
descriptions.V-THREADWELL: A mouse tailor who believes everyone deserves a better hat.
descriptions.V-FENWICK: A magpie who sells sealed card packs and cannot resist anything shiny.
descriptions.V-ALEMBIC: An otherworldly alchemist who brews multi-Path cards from essence.
